title: G5: Don't automatically un-pair on phones that can't automatically re-pair
body: Some phones (like mine) require user intervention to pair with a Bluetooth device. Right now, the old and new G5 collectors can automatically un-pair from the G5 to try to resolve a connection problem. On phones that can't re-pair automatically, this just makes things worse -- the original problem might have resolved by itself, but now xDrip won't get any data until the user manually intervenes. In those cases, xDrip should not automatically un-pair at all.

comments.body: I'm working on this now and hopefully will have something out tomorrow you can try out.
